messages:
maya: FYI customer (Acme Analytics) reports that the Team Overview chart legend shows all counts as 0 after they apply the 'last 7d' + team filter on mobile. They see numbers correct on desktop. Escalating.

sam: Can you paste the dashboard link and a screenshot? Need OS/browser details.

maya: https://console.redwood.ai/dash/teams/abc123 -- screenshot attached in thread (mobile chrome). They say tooltip still shows the right value but legend count is 0 for every row. :thinking_face:

tara-qa: Repro steps from customer: 1) Login mobile chrome 2) Open Team Overview 3) Toggle time range to 7d 4) Select team filter = "Platform" 5) Legend shows zeros, chart bars render correctly.

li: Assigning to eng-frontend. Sam — can you confirm if this is a rendering + client-side formatter issue or a backend payload problem? If backend wrong we'd see desktop mismatch too.

sam: Quick check — desktop payload for that endpoint (api/v1/dash/teams?range=7d&team=Platform) returns counts as expected. So likely client JS is losing the counts when resizing to compact layout.

sam: Adding a quick console log to prod-preview to see the data object shape. If anyone can capture network tab from mobile emulator that would help.

maya: Customer provided a HAR, sending snippet:

```
{"series": [{"label":"Team A","value":427},{"label":"Platform","value":0},{"label":"Team C","value":312}], "meta":{...}}
```

They say payload actually shows Platform=0 in HAR but desktop payload shows 40. Hmm inconsistent.

li: That smells like an intermittent proxy/cache or a routing edge that sometimes returns stale/filtered results. Could be sticky to a replica that's lagging. Which region is customer in?

maya: Region = eu-west-1. They are on dedicated capacity.

sam: I just pushed a branch that forces a parity check in the client: if chart series totals don't match legend totals, we log an error with request id. Dropping a canary to prod-preview.

tara-qa: I can repro consistently on mobile chrome in emulator when I throttle CPU to 2x slowdown. Repro steps show legend recalculation runs before async label fetch resolves, so we end up writing 0s.

sam: Thanks — that points to a race. Possible fix: compute legend values from the final merged series after async transforms, not from initial placeholder. I'll open a PR to gate legend render until data fully resolved.

maya: Customer is urgent (billing dashboard linked to these counts). Marking P1 for now. Notifying account team. @support-bot created incident:INC-4872.

support-bot: Incident INC-4872 created and linked to customer Acme Analytics. Severity: P1.

li: I'll check cluster replica lag for eu-west-1 and search for any recent deploys that touched caching layer. If replicas are lagging that'll explain the inconsistent payloads between devices.

sam: PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/frontend/pulls/4523 — adds guard to legend rendering + unit test. Requesting review from @li.

maya: Customer confirmed workaround: switch to desktop or toggle time range twice clears the 0s. They don't want that as a long-term solution.

li: Follow-ups: 1) Roll patch to gate legend render 2) Investigate replica lag / cache invalidation in eu-west-1 3) Add telemetry to catch when legend total != series total (so we can alert).

sam: I'll merge the patch to prod-preview once CI passes, then roll to canary. Will report back with trace ids.

maya: Thanks everyone — please update this thread with the canary timestamp and customer-facing note.

sam: Canary rolled at 2025-11-21T18:32:10Z (trace id: trace-0a1b2c). Early checks show no legend-0 events in prod-preview logs.

maya: Passing to account team for customer update. Closing on slack once we confirm stable for 24h.

li: Logged a follow-up ticket to investigate edge caching: ENG-INFRA-219.

tara-qa: I will run regression on iOS/android matrix tomorrow.

maya: Closing notes for the thread: root cause = client-side race+possible stale payloads in one edge replica. Immediate mitigation = gate legend render. Medium-term = infra investigation + telemetry.

sam: :white_check_mark:
